comparison.objective: Seat a keyed coupling and demonstrate that it transfers drive rotation.
comparison.physical_skill: Align unequal drive dogs, insert/seat the coupling, and maintain engagement under rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Continuous coupling engagement and lower-rotor motion caused through the coupling; direct robot drive of the rotor is rejected. Exact numeric thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both require a functional post-manipulation test, this record tests keyed insertion and torque transmission. The candidate tests tuning and locking a variable damper followed by bounded stopping behavior.
